## Yuyake 0.0.2
### Added
- Quitting or updating Yuyake leaves your macOS wallpaper as it was, and Settings, Storage has a "Restore macOS wallpaper" button - Help menu: Send Feedback and Copy Diagnostics, with nothing sent unless you choose to
### Changed
- Privacy text now lists every connection Yuyake makes - Weather comes only from Open-Meteo; Apple WeatherKit is gone - Rotation, schedules and collections have no limits, and the unused Pro and StoreKit code is removed
### Learn more
https://pennowick.com/yuyake/
Full changelog: https://github.com/yuyakeapp/yuyake-releases/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
